failures.criterion: Review item 3 / the ask-edit route on a decision off its content rule: the refusal tells the caller to send options to rebuild them as one list, and an edit that sends options repairs the decision
failures.evidence: Real surface: a decision broken by two real editors (`- Option A` / `* Option B`). PATCH /api/v1/asks/<id> {"question":"Which one now?","options":[{"label":"Option A"},{"label":"Option B"}]} gives 400 ASK_BLOCK_TEXT 'options: the block carries 1 options, not 2', and nothing is written. In round 1 at acd9df19 the same call repaired the block. Cause in ask_block_text.go: askBlockChildren sets edit.Options to nil when the sent options equal askBlockOf's joined reading (:191-193), and its loop keeps only the last bullet_list (:177-183), so the rebuilt block holds one list and verifyAskBlockRoundTrip refuses it. When only options are sent, askBlockBodyChanges reports no change, the edit writes attributes only, and refuseAskContentBreak refuses again with 'send options to rebuild the options as one list'. Red test in commit 70ba7991: `cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres go test ./internal/dispatch/docs/ -count=1 -run TestSetAskBlockTextRepairsATwoListAskWhenSentEveryOptionItHolds -v`. It fails in both subtests: options_only gives 'block: … holds a second bullet list …; send options to rebuild the options as one list', and options_and_question gives 'options: the block carries 1 options, not 3'. The implementer's TestSetAskBlockTextRefusesAnEditLeavingASecondBulletList passes only because it sends a subset ([Ship, Defer] of [Ship, Hold, Defer]).

editorRepairPaths.how: Throwaway Playwright probes in chromium against the real Go server and Postgres. Each break was made by two real editors with their connections held (the paragraph-after-list order retried on fresh issues until the merge gave it). For each key sequence I read the stored markdown, the malformed attribute on both pages, the ask row and page errors. Record: https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2433#issuecomment-6468958451
editorRepairPaths.observed: No page error and no unselected word lost in any of 18 sequences. Two lists, repaired with: Delete at the end of the first list (joins; ask takes both options); select across into the second list then Backspace or Ctrl+X; empty the second item then Backspace x3; Backspace at the start of a one-item first list (lifts into the question). Paragraph after the list, repaired with: Backspace at its start (joins into the option); empty it then Backspace; select from the option's end then Backspace; Delete at the option's end (it becomes an option); Ctrl+X then Backspace. Typing in the question, the options and the paragraph works. Keys the guard declines: Enter in the question (no new paragraph), the second Enter on an empty item, and a lift whose result still breaks the rule. A keyboard repair exists next to each of these.
editorRepairPaths.verdict: the architect's editor criteria hold: a person can repair either break from the keyboard, and no key fails silently without a repair path
